description: Manage clients, plans, sessions, habits, and billing on Trainzilla via one-click OAuth.

tool_signatures.name: assign_coach_to_location
tool_signatures.description: Assign or move a coach to a location within the organization, with a role there (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: assign_master_habit
tool_signatures.description: Assign a Master Habit to one or more clients — creates a habit per client (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: assign_organization_member_role
tool_signatures.description: Give a gym member a custom role, or clear it by omitting roleId (confirm-gated). Owner or admin — an access-control change, so confirm exactly which member and role first.

tool_signatures.name: calc_1rm
tool_signatures.description: Estimate a 1-rep max (Epley) and %1RM weight suggestions from a working set.

tool_signatures.name: calc_macros
tool_signatures.description: Compute a macro split (protein/carbs/fat in grams) for a strategy. STANDARD=40/30/30, PRO=g/kg multipliers, KETO=25/5/70.

tool_signatures.name: calc_tdee
tool_signatures.description: Compute BMR, TDEE, and recommended daily calories from client stats.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_gym_class_session
tool_signatures.description: Cancel one dated class session (confirm-gated). Booked members are affected — confirm which session first.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_session
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a scheduled session (confirm-gated). Optionally give a short reason the client will see.

tool_signatures.name: close_organization
tool_signatures.description: Close a gym (confirm-gated) — owner only, high impact: unlists its plans and public page and releases its coaches. Blocked while gym-plan subscribers are live. Get explicit, typed-out confirmation of which gym before calling with confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: create_checkin
tool_signatures.description: Schedule a check-in for a client with optional questions (confirm-gated). scheduledFor: ISO date. question.type: TEXT|NUMBER|SCALE|PHOTO.

tool_signatures.name: create_gym_class
tool_signatures.description: Create a recurring gym class (confirm-gated). Members can then book its sessions.

tool_signatures.name: create_organization
tool_signatures.description: Create a new organization (confirm-gated) — the coach becomes its owner.

tool_signatures.name: create_organization_location
tool_signatures.description: Add a new location/branch to an organization (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: create_prospect
tool_signatures.description: Manually add a prospect to the pipeline (confirm-gated) — for a lead that came in outside the platform (a call, a walk-in, a referral).

tool_signatures.name: deactivate_gym_class
tool_signatures.description: Stop a recurring class from running (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: delete_diet_plan
tool_signatures.description: Delete a diet plan for good (confirm-gated). The client loses access to it — prefer editing unless the coach clearly wants it gone.

tool_signatures.name: delete_diet_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a diet plan template (confirm-gated). This does not touch any plan already assigned to a client from it.

tool_signatures.name: delete_organization_custom_role
tool_signatures.description: Delete a custom gym role (confirm-gated). Owner only. Get explicit confirmation of exactly which role first — members holding it lose its access.

tool_signatures.name: delete_organization_location
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a location (confirm-gated). Coaches and clients assigned to it are not moved automatically — reassign them first.

tool_signatures.name: delete_workout_plan
tool_signatures.description: Delete a workout plan for good (confirm-gated). The client loses access to it — prefer editing unless the coach clearly wants it gone.

tool_signatures.name: delete_workout_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a workout plan template (confirm-gated). This does not touch any plan already assigned to a client from it.

tool_signatures.name: get_diet_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Full detail of one diet plan template, including every meal.

tool_signatures.name: get_gym_attendance_summary
tool_signatures.description: Member attendance (booked / attended / no-show) and per-class fill rate over a date range.

tool_signatures.name: get_gym_class_roster
tool_signatures.description: Who is booked into one class session and whether they attended. Use list_gym_class_sessions for the session id.

tool_signatures.name: get_habit_compliance
tool_signatures.description: Habit compliance percentage (0-100) for a client over a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

tool_signatures.name: get_my_pending_org_invitations
tool_signatures.description: Organization invitations this coach has received and not yet responded to (e.g. an invite to join a gym as staff).

tool_signatures.name: get_organization_dashboard
tool_signatures.description: Organization-wide totals: clients and revenue overall, and broken down per location and per coach.

tool_signatures.name: get_organization_earnings
tool_signatures.description: Gym earnings statement for a period: total, per-coach totals, and each payment with who sold it and who coaches that client now, plus the payout mode. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. Payouts are settled outside the app.

tool_signatures.name: get_organization_hierarchy
tool_signatures.description: Full org structure: locations, coaches with their roles and assigned locations, and pending invites. Use list_my_organizations for the id.

tool_signatures.name: get_organization_role_guide
tool_signatures.description: What each built-in gym role (OWNER, ADMIN, PRIMARY_COACH, COACH) is allowed to do.

tool_signatures.name: get_prospect_stats
tool_signatures.description: Counts of prospects by pipeline stage (new / contacted / hot / warm / did not pick up / converted / not interested / low budget / out of radius / legacy lost) for the coach.

tool_signatures.name: get_workout_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Full detail of one workout plan template, including every exercise.

tool_signatures.name: invite_client_to_organization
tool_signatures.description: Invite a client to join the organization by email, optionally pre-assigned to a coach and location (confirm-gated). They receive a real email.

tool_signatures.name: invite_coach_to_organization
tool_signatures.description: Invite a coach to join the organization by email, with a role and optional location (confirm-gated). They receive a real email.

tool_signatures.name: list_invitations
tool_signatures.description: List invitations the coach has sent to prospective clients (pending, accepted, rejected).

tool_signatures.name: list_my_organizations
tool_signatures.description: Organizations the coach belongs to (owns, manages, or is a member of), with their role in each.

tool_signatures.name: list_organization_custom_roles
tool_signatures.description: Custom roles defined for a gym (name, the capabilities each carries, member count), plus who holds which role and the capabilities that can be delegated to a custom role.

tool_signatures.name: list_organization_payments
tool_signatures.description: Payments received across the gym (all coaches), newest first. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit.

tool_signatures.name: list_organization_seat_tiers
tool_signatures.description: The gym subscription tiers on offer: seat limit, billing mode and price per currency (smallest unit). For a gym deciding what to buy or upgrade to.

tool_signatures.name: mark_gym_class_attendance
tool_signatures.description: Record who attended a class session (confirm-gated). Get member userIds from get_gym_class_roster.

tool_signatures.name: record_organization_coach_attendance
tool_signatures.description: Mark a coach present/absent/late/on-leave at a location for a date (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: remove_coach_from_organization
tool_signatures.description: Remove a coach from the organization entirely (confirm-gated) — high impact: optionally transfer their clients to another coach in the same call, or their clients are left unassigned. Get explicit confirmation of exactly which coach, and where their clients go, before calling with confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: remove_coach_location_assignment
tool_signatures.description: Unassign a coach from a location within the organization (confirm-gated). Does not remove them from the organization itself — use remove_coach_from_organization for that.

tool_signatures.name: reschedule_session
tool_signatures.description: Move a session to a new time (confirm-gated). newStart/newEnd are ISO date-time strings. Both client and coach are notified by the existing flow.

tool_signatures.name: send_invitation
tool_signatures.description: Invite a prospective client to join Trainzilla under this coach, by email (confirm-gated). They receive an email with a signup link.

tool_signatures.name: set_diet_plan_template_marketplace
tool_signatures.description: List or unlist a diet plan template on the Trainzilla marketplace, and set its price (confirm-gated). This does not process any payment — it only makes the template available for other coaches to buy.

tool_signatures.name: set_workout_plan_template_marketplace
tool_signatures.description: List or unlist a workout plan template on the Trainzilla marketplace, and set its price (confirm-gated). This does not process any payment — it only makes the template available for other coaches to buy.

tool_signatures.name: transfer_organization_ownership
tool_signatures.description: Hand a gym to another member (confirm-gated) — owner only and irreversible by the current owner; gym-owned plans move to the new owner. Get explicit confirmation of exactly who becomes the owner before calling with confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: update_diet_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Edit an existing diet plan template (confirm-gated). Only send the fields that change.

tool_signatures.name: update_organization_ai_guidelines
tool_signatures.description: Set the gym-wide rules the AI assistant and AI coach follow for every coach and client in the gym (confirm-gated). Replaces the whole text — read get_organization_profile first to edit rather than overwrite.

tool_signatures.name: update_organization_location
tool_signatures.description: Rename or re-address an existing location (confirm-gated).

tool_signatures.name: update_prospect_status
tool_signatures.description: Move a prospect to a new pipeline stage (confirm-gated). Use list_prospects to get the id.

tool_signatures.name: update_workout_plan_template
tool_signatures.description: Edit an existing workout plan template (confirm-gated). Only send the fields that change.

tool_signatures.name: whoami
tool_signatures.description: Return the authenticated coach (user id, name, email, role) and trainer id. Use to verify the connection.
